title: Arkret Applet Protocol Object
description: Schema-registry object for applet protocol metadata snapshots. Event payloads for ck.applet.* MUST use the typed payload definitions in event-payload.schema.json; this object is not a loose transport envelope and is closed at the top level except for x_* extensions.

applet_id.description: Stable applet identifier. MUST be either a DID or the registered typed-id form ck:applet:<uuidv7>. Arbitrary opaque strings are not valid wire identifiers; bridge-specific aliases belong in namespace / external_ref fields.

service_did.description: DID of the service that hosts the applet runtime (used by registration / discovery).

session_id.description: Per-invocation correlation id used by interop_session.start / .status to pair request/response.

runtime_status.description: Bridge-implementation-defined runtime status for ck.applet.interop_session.status events. v1 does NOT mandate a canonical applet session state machine (unlike ck.agent.* which uses the 9-value agent_interop_session_status enum); bridges MAY restrict the set further in their applet manifest. The field name is `runtime_status` (not `status`) to keep applet object snapshots distinguishable from the canonical agent session state machine in agent.schema.json.

params.description: Caller-supplied parameters for interop_session.start. Opaque to the Arkret protocol — bridge implementations interpret per applet manifest.

detail.description: Bridge-side detail surface (echo response payload, error context, bridge identifier, etc.). Free-form object; bridges document their own schema.

manifest.description: Applet manifest snapshot at registration time (capability requirements, supported intents, etc.).
